summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments from automated reviewers (GitHub Copilot) by analyzing each comment, implementing fixes, and replying/resolving threads.
summary.outcome: Fixed polling timeout mismatches in release-gate.yml (MAX_ATTEMPTS 40→90 for both web and desktop), fixed a skipped-jobs false-failure bug in both fallback checks, committed and pushed two commits, and resolved 2 review threads.

repo: release-gate.yml has separate web and desktop E2E polling loops, each with their own MAX_ATTEMPTS and job timeout values that must stay in sync.
Both web and desktop fallback checks shared the same bug: if all jobs in a run are skipped, TOTAL > 0 but SUCCESS = 0 causes a false failure rather than continuing the search.

code.finding: Polling MAX_ATTEMPTS was 40 (20 min) for web but the desktop job timeout was 45 min, and desktop MAX_ATTEMPTS was 40 (20 min) against a 50 min job timeout — both needed to be raised to 90.
Fallback logic must filter out skipped jobs before evaluating pass/fail; otherwise an all-skipped run is treated as a failure instead of a signal to keep searching.

workflow: Use --field (not -f) for integer parameters like in_reply_to when calling gh api for PR comment replies.
Review thread resolution requires GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread with the thread node ID, separate from REST comment replies.
When fixing reviewer-flagged issues, check all analogous code paths for the same bug — both web and desktop fallbacks had identical skipped-jobs logic.

friction: The skipped-jobs edge case was not caught by the original polling logic and required a second fix pass after the initial timeout fixes.
